### Hang in There
Author: Michael Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-june-10-2025.html
Passage: Acts 18:9-10
Points:
- Paul arrived in Corinth feeling discouraged after facing lukewarm results in Athens.
- God reassured him through a night vision that he was not alone and was divinely protected.
- Lasting kingdom success rests on God’s power and timing rather than human strength.
- Believers can overcome fear and doubt by trusting God's faithfulness in the work He assigns.

### Paul at Corinth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/paul-at-corinth
Passage: Acts 18:7-11
Points:
- When faced with intense opposition in the Corinthian synagogue, Paul relocated to the home of a Gentile believer.
- God brought fruit despite the resistance, including the conversion of the synagogue leader and his household.
- Jesus encouraged Paul with a promise of personal protection and revealed He had many people in the city.
- Reassured by Christ's presence, Paul persevered for a year and a half teaching God's word in Corinth.
